title: Chainer Open-Source Release
summary: Preferred Infrastructure and Preferred Networks announced on June 9, 2015 that they had developed the Chainer deep-learning framework and released it as open-source software.
significance: A dated public open-source release milestone for the Chainer deep-learning framework, preserved as a release event rather than an inferred invention or system-birth date.

verification.note: Preferred Networks' first-party announcement dated June 9, 2015 states that Preferred Infrastructure and Preferred Networks developed the Chainer deep-learning framework and released it as open-source software. Later first-party Preferred Networks materials independently describe Chainer as having been open-sourced in June 2015. This candidate records the June 9 public open-source release milestone only; it does not infer the framework's invention date, development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.

sources.title: Open-source deep learning framework Chainer released
Preferred Networks released ChainerMN, a multi-node extension to Chainer, an open source framework for deep learning

candidateMeta.admissionReason: A dated first-party announcement directly supports Chainer's June 9, 2015 open-source release, and later first-party material corroborates the June 2015 open-sourcing milestone.
